content.comment_body: I own a new [product_name] now. I'm having trouble accessing the remote device. I've read several forum articles but couldn't find a solution that works for me. I also tried information from other sites. What I've done: I updated my [product_name] software to [version_no]. I can ping my PC from the [product_name], and the [product_name] from my PC. I've connected both via a router and directly, but still no luck. [product_name] IP is 192.168.1.25, PC is 192.168.1.35; both use subnet mask 255.255.255.0; both have gateway set to 192.168.1.1. I can find the accessible [product_name] at the target IP and its status is 'yes'. However, when I test the connection, I always get the message "Unable to access the remote device". In the network project, going online also detects the [product_name]. So, I'm likely missing something. Any advice?

Does your router use DHCP? This can cause problems if PC and [product_name] have addresses within the range the router assigns automatically. You can enter the router's address as the gateway in the [product_name].
Issue solved. It turned out to be my laptop's firewall.

I can go online, but I cannot upload or download; I receive the same message, "Unable to access the remote device". I connect the [product_name] via LAN and have already checked my laptop's firewall. I'm using firmware [version_no] and [product_name] software [version_no]. Can anyone assist?

analysis.insight_summary: Users are experiencing difficulties accessing a remote [product_name] device on a local network and consistently encounter an 'Unable to access the remote device' error. Although basic network connectivity is confirmed (ping works), and the device appears as accessible, program transfers are failing. Main issues include firewall restrictions and DHCP or IP conflicts, but some users continue to experience problems after attempting these solutions.
analysis.user_expectations: Users seek reliable remote access between their PC and [product_name] device over a LAN connection, enabling easy upload and download. They expect straightforward troubleshooting steps in case of connection problems.
